title: LLM Ruby Algorithm Error Benchmark
description: A Ruby on Rails research artifact for studying human-in-the-loop governance in LLM-assisted algorithm implementation. The repository preserves prompt, result, error, correction, solver, fixture, and verification records across 28 prompts and nine algorithm families: Traveling Salesman, Vehicle Routing, Assignment, Max Flow, Min Cost Flow, Job Shop Scheduling, Moon Phase Calculations, N-Queens, and SAT solving.
